_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. Release: September 15, 2026 on PS5 only. Insomniac announced the date on X in February 2026, and the PlayStation Blog repeated it (blog.playstation.com, 2026-09-14). Story names: Omega Red, Mystique and the Madripoor and Tokyo settings come from the PlayStation Blog. The rest of the plot (Team X, Essex, Trask, the Reavers, the Hand, the Helix Engine, Walter Langkowski, Skullbuster, Tyger Tiger, Callisto, the Phoenix Force twist, Apocalypse, Master Mold, James Howlett) and the voice cast come from the Wikipedia article on the game. Reviews (NME, RTE, TechRaptor) agree on these. Boss guides list Omega Red, the Sentinel Prototype, Lady Deathstrike, Sabretooth and Essex as the final boss. Weak words: Wolverine, Logan, Jean Grey, Mystique, Sabretooth, Callisto, Leech, Sunfire and Phoenix are Marvel characters who also show up in films, comics and other games such as Marvel Rivals. Several are also ordinary words, first names or places (Callisto is a moon, Phoenix and Essex are real places). Apocalypse, Sentinel, Hand and Horsemen are ordinary words. Reavers is also a Firefly term. Trask and Howlett are surnames. Every voice actor is weak. Canada, Vancouver and Tokyo are left out because they are too general to help. Left out because they are unconfirmed: the identity of the third-act betrayer beyond what Wikipedia says, and the 'Nature Girl' cameo (only one review mentions it). Accounts: InsomniacGames posted the release date. PlayStation is left out because it posts about every PS game.
name: Marvel's Wolverine
